curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: use 4-6 letter words in short sentences

interactions.feedback: Yes! Home has four letters: h-o-m-e.
interactions.retryHint: Count one letter at a time.

interactions.prompt: Choose the two words with 4 to 6 letters.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Chief has 5 letters and helps has 5 letters.
interactions.retryHint: Count the letters; keep words with 4, 5, or 6.

interactions.prompt: Arrange the 4-6 letter words to make a short sentence.
interactions.feedback: Well built! Every word has 4 to 6 letters.
interactions.retryHint: Start with Chief, then say what the chief does.

interactions.prompt: Complete the short sentence with a 4-6 letter word: The chief is ___.
interactions.feedback: Great! Kind has four letters and completes the sentence.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the answer with exactly four letters.

interactions.prompt: Build a short sentence using these words.
interactions.feedback: Nice writing! People trust Chief uses words of 4 to 6 letters.
interactions.retryHint: Begin with People, then add the action trust.

interactions.prompt: Which short sentence uses only 4-6 letter words?
interactions.feedback: Sentence champion! Chief, helps, and people each have 4 to 6 letters.
interactions.retryHint: Count the letters in every word of the sentence.
